# <a id="_Toc201131725"></a>Procedure for integrating Threat Intelligence into Development Lifecycle

The document is a formal procedure for the consumption and distribution of threat intelligence information\.

##### Policy Tag

[Incident Management Policy](https://siemensnam.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/teams/disw_ISMS/Policies/Siemens%20Industry%20Software%20(SISW)%20SaaS%20Incident%20Management%20Policy.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=VvO6Lw)

##### Scope

- CLOUD\_ART development team

## <a id="_Toc201131726"></a>Principles

Attackers constantly change their attack TTP’s; defenders must likewise remain up to date with trends and changes in attacker activities\.

## <a id="_Toc137544288"></a><a id="_Toc138404965"></a><a id="_Toc201131727"></a>Roles and Responsibilities

FDS CSO

Gathers, consolidates and applies threat intelligence

Shares pertinent TI with operating teams as required

SIEMENS CERT

Gathers, consolidates and applies threat intelligence

Shares pertinent TI with operating teams as required

PSSO/PSSE

Gathers, consolidates and applies threat intelligence

Shares pertinent TI with operating teams as required

## <a id="_Toc201131728"></a>Procedures

### Gather 

Various sources are available for individuals to gather threat intelligence: Podcasts, news feeds, LinkedIn\. The PSSO or PSSE gathers these\. 

SIEMENS CERT distributes TI on a weekly basis\. Users can subscribe to the [CTI News Portal](https://news.cert.siemens.com/news/)

### Distribute

- Place particularly important documents in [External Reports](https://siemensnam.sharepoint.com/:f:/r/teams/disw_plc_coi_fdo/cyber/Shared%20Documents/External%20Reports?csf=1&web=1&e=xV7pxd) \. Examples include Verizon DBIR and Mandiant MTrends\.
- Email PSSE’s and architect when particularly relevant or important attacks happen
- Open ticket with CSO in case a certain attack is relevant to the architecture in question
- Discuss TI trends in PI Planning kick off\.
- Consider recent trends and attack methods during threat modeling
